claim: The ECB raises its deposit rate by 0.25 points
resolution_rule: YES if the September 10 decision increases the deposit facility rate by exactly 0.25 percentage points relative to the rate immediately before that decision. Any other change or a hold is NO.

claim: US core CPI rises 0.2% or 0.3% in August
resolution_rule: YES if the initial September 11 BLS release reports August CPI-U, all items less food and energy, at 0.2% or 0.3% month over month, seasonally adjusted. Use the published rounded figure, not later revisions.

claim: No Swedish party wins an outright majority
resolution_rule: YES if every party has fewer than 175 seats in the official 2026 allocation. Use a final result available by September 22, 23:59 Stockholm time; if only preliminary figures exist, label the assessment provisional and leave final scoring pending.

claim: The Fed raises its target range by 0.25 points
resolution_rule: YES if both bounds of the federal funds target range rise exactly 0.25 percentage points in the scheduled September 16 decision relative to the pre-meeting range. A hold, cut, or differently sized rise is NO.

claim: The Bank of England keeps Bank Rate at 3.75%
resolution_rule: YES if the September 17 MPC announcement sets Bank Rate at 3.75%. Any different announced rate is NO.

claim: The Bank of Japan keeps its rate guideline around 1%
resolution_rule: YES if the September 18 policy statement retains an overnight call-rate guideline of around 1.0%. A different guideline is NO; the daily traded market rate is not the scoring measure.

claim: China leads the Asian Games gold table by September 22
resolution_rule: YES if China is ranked first by gold medals on the official table at September 22, 23:59 Japan time. Break ties by silver then bronze; an exact tie counts as joint first and YES. If no medals have been awarded or no official tally is recoverable, leave unresolved.

claim: Climate appears in at least half of the first ten UN national speeches
resolution_rule: Review the first ten completed Member State statements in official speaking order on September 22, excluding the Secretary-General and Assembly President. Count explicit climate change, global warming, or climate finance references, including clear equivalents in official translations. YES at five or more. If fewer than ten finish that day, leave unresolved.
